appearance.intro: How Agentry looks and moves in this browser. Stored here, not on the server.
appearance.themeHint: System follows your operating system's light or dark setting.
appearance.languageHint: The language of the interface. What Claude writes is never translated.
appearance.motionHint: Spinners, pulsing rails and counters say what an agent is doing right now.

motionDescriptions.full: Everything moves, including the loops that show what is alive.
motionDescriptions.subtle: Transitions only: spinners hold still and nothing loops.

appearance.reducedForced: Your system asks for reduced motion, so nothing moves while that setting is on. The choice below applies again once it is turned off.
